title: Answer: dissociate awareness from attention, image the brain, build agents

statements.text: AST is checked by keeping attention on a stimulus outside awareness and measuring whether its control fails, by imaging which networks track awareness-dependent control, by testing whether people model others’ attention, and by giving artificial agents an attention schema or withholding it.

sources.quote: Recently, this control-theory prediction was tested using artificial neural-network models trained to engage in simple forms of spatial attention
